title: Archuleta reports a crashed plane to the Air Force
place_text: Archuleta ranch / Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: He calls the Air Force and he [music] says, "Hey, one of your planes crashed over here. You need to come get it."

plain: In 1948 a New Mexico rancher named Valentine Archeletta found a crashed craft on his land and called the Air Force, telling them, "Hey, one of your planes crashed over here. You need to come get it." The researcher Scott Ramsey tells Michels this as Archeletta's own account, in a story tied to Kirtland Air Force Base. If true, it would mean the military learned of the crash from a rancher who took it for one of its own aircraft.
